limit_case.case: Translation, 1,000 words at the $10 Fiverr tier
limit_case.market_reference: Fiverr gig: $10 per 1,000 words (Part 1.8). The standard cheat in this market is raw machine output sold as manual translation. The two samples here are built from the same varied source text: one intact, one with the word order inside every sentence scrambled, which is what word for word machine output does to a text.
limit_case.finding: Both samples pass every check, including the anti stuffing screen: scrambled word order keeps natural text statistics, because varied words in the wrong order are still varied words. Counting proves length and term presence; it cannot judge translation quality. This is the honest limit of the rule based verifier, and it is why the paper frames the checks as proof of delivery shape, not proof of craft.
